notes:
Context: mid-market CX SaaS building an in-product conversational assistant + semantic search. Started with hosted API for quick validation (embeddings + chat flows). After validating latency/cost tradeoffs they are moving to evaluate Redwood Dedicated for predictable SLOs and data isolation. Key asks: canary rollout support, automatic fallback routing (model variants + region failover), strong audit trails, and KMS integration for key management.

POC scope (agreed verbally): deploy 1 Dedicated cluster in us-west with VPC peering + optional eu-west standby. Run two canonical workloads: (1) chat support for end-users (p50 < 80ms, p95 < 150ms for assistant streaming tokens), targeted concurrency: 60-100 concurrent sessions; (2) semantic search + reranking for recommendations (embedding throughput 20 req/s, rerank latency p95 < 200ms).

Canary + fallback plan (POC detail, engineering wants this verbatim):
- Canary stage: route 5% of production-like traffic to Dedicated canary nodes for 72 hours; compare latency/cost/quality with hosted baseline.
- Model variants: primary = open-model-13b-fp16 (low-latency), fallback variant = open-model-7b-8bit (cost-optimized), safety fallback = small-safe-policy model for degraded scenarios.
- Routing policy: smart-routing by policy — prefer Dedicated in-region; if Dedicated capacity breached then fallback to hosted_api in same region; if regional outage then failover to eu-standby region (with data residency flagging for sensitive records).
- Rollback: automatic rollback to prior model variant + route shift back to hosted if SLA breach detected for >10 minutes or error rate >2%. Alerting hooks to PagerDuty and Slack channel #meadowwing-ops.

Security/compliance: Meadowwing requires SSO/SAML for console access, KMS integration for key isolation, per-request audit logs retained 13 months, and option to restrict residency to EU for certain customer cohorts. Legal requested SOC2 and ISO attestation docs (INF-4821 ticket opened).

Commercial: Procurement asked two committed-tier pricing scenarios (yearly reserved vs monthly burstable) with detailed per-token and per-embedding cost lines. Est ARR target range provided above.

Quotes / paraphrases: "Need deterministic latency — embeddings/recall is fine but chat must feel realtime for users" — Head of Product. 

Open items: finalize SOW, provide SOC2 packaging, confirm VPC egress rules and subnet/CIDR list, agree exact canary traffic percentage and success metrics.

Short / CRM-style next actions: 1) Send Dedicated POC SOW + infra checklist (Riley) by 2026-03-15. 2) Maya to run canary config workshop and provide simulated traffic plan by 2026-03-18. 3) Security team to upload SOC2/ISO artifacts to drive link (assigned to Redwood Security).
